svg.text: PART 1: STEPPER MOTOR AND DRV8825 DRIVER
Test setup for step 3. The Nucleo runs from the laptop USB; the motor runs from the 12 V adapter.
USB cable to the laptop (power and code)
chip side up, VMOT and EN in column 12
find the two coil pairs first
Motor cable: black + green = coil A (A1, A2)
M2 to 3.3 V, M0 and M1 open: 1/16 step,
SLP and RST to 3.3 V: driver awake
10 kΩ on EN: motor stays off until the
Current: about 0.5 V on the potentiometer
FLT and the GND above DIR: no wire needed
1. Wire everything with the adapter and the USB unplugged.
2. Top + rail is 12 V, bottom + rail is 3.3 V: mark them with tape.
3. Never plug or unplug the motor while 12 V is on.
4. Power on: USB first, then the adapter.
5. Power off: adapter first, then the USB.
6. Check every Nucleo pin label before plugging.
Kibbly hardware · circuit 1 of the circuits by part · wires V1 to V22 in hardware/04_wiring_list.md section 6B
